headlines.snippet: The Privacy Protection Authority determined that the Ministry of Education leaked sensitive information on 21,000 special education students. The findings stem from an administrative oversight process initiated last year following the leak of medical information of a Haredi student. The review revealed that a mechanism intended to streamline student placement was insecure and open for viewing. Private information from the system, such as identification details, home addresses, and medical information, was leaked. The authority stated that sensitive information reached unauthorized individuals and entities.

headlines.snippet: The Privacy Protection Authority ruled that the Ministry of Education violated the law in the negligent leak of information on special education students. Following the N12 exposure of sensitive information leak concerning approximately 21,000 Haredi special education students, the Ministry of Justice's oversight process has concluded.
